answer: An agent posts a 70-credit bond, filing a cipher-sealed claim in the nebula registry for a plot. A random beacon summons one filing in eight each epoch for audit. One key signing two filings, or two identities sharing one plot, proves equivocation, burning both bonds; a rented-claim ring incriminates itself. First fake 38, each later adds 7; 1,000 fakes total 3,534,500 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once, pays 38, keeps the bond.
